source.snippet: I am looking for a ready-to-use or well-documented software library/SDK to add client-side end-to-end encryption to an existing chat application. Current stack: Backend: NestJS / TypeScript, Desktop client: Electron, Mobile clients: React Native for iOS and Android. Existing product: custom chat application, not based on Matrix or Signal. Current state: no E2EE yet. Goal: add real client-side E2EE before offering the product to other companies. Required features: One-to-one encrypted messaging, Group e[ncryption]...

problem_statement: Developers building commercial chat products cannot find a well-documented, cross-platform E2EE SDK (Electron + React Native + NestJS) to ship client-side encryption before selling to enterprise customers, blocking their go-to-market.
target_segment: Indie developers and small software teams building B2B chat or collaboration SaaS products who need to add E2EE as a compliance or sales requirement.
notes: Buyer signal is explicit: the poster already has a product and needs E2EE *before offering it to other companies* — i.e., a sales gate. They are actively looking for a paid or licensable library. Gap exists because Matrix/Signal SDKs don't fit non-Matrix stacks cleanly. Opportunity: a turnkey E2EE messaging SDK with clear docs for the NestJS/Electron/React Native stack, or a hosted key-management + encryption service with those client libs.
